name: The Old Gate
_comment: The first step of the centipede's story, in order (Hayden, 11 Nov 2026): the gate asks yes or no (recorded either way, the therapist marker), but it never opens on its own. A yes is a whisper towards the castle school, where she has her corner behind the walls and gulps you down to Dark Hollow (scripts/centipede_corner.gd). Once Dark Hollow is mended she moves up to her hollow log behind this gate, and from then on it opens: that's her home (scripts/scary_world.gd).

lines: (The old gate's standing open a crack. Warm violet light spills out, and there's a smell of moss and mushrooms. Somebody lives here now.)
({player} steps back. That's okay. The gate will still be here.)

rotate: (The old gate's still shut tight. Mist curls between the bars. Somewhere inside, a glow-bug blinks.)
(A whisper, from nowhere at all: "...not this way... behind the walls... the school...")
(The gate won't budge. Something long rustles away through the leaves on the other side.)
(The whisper again: "...the far, far corner... behind the walls...")

lines: (The old gate creaks. It's dark and misty on the other side, and something long skitters away into the shadows...)
(A sign says SCARY WORLD. Underneath, in very small letters: it's really not that bad.)
({player} steps back from the gate. Saying no is brave too.)

choice.text: Yes, I want to go in.
lines: ({player} takes a deep breath and pushes. The gate rattles... but it won't open. It's shut tight.)
(Something long and leggy rustles away on the other side. Then a whisper, soft as moths: "...not this way...")
("...behind the walls... at the school... the far, far corner...")
